recipe.visualDefinition: A circular graphic emblem styled as a traditional tattoo, featuring a central textured citrus fruit surrounded by a ring of bubble-style lettering and exploding 3D stars, all set against a close-up, softly lit skin texture.
coreVisualRelationships: Concentric arrangement of text around a central sphere
Explosive radial movement of stars from the center
Contrast between the flat, bold graphic and the realistic skin background
Heavy black outlines unifying disparate elements
coreInvariants: Heavy black line weight for all graphic elements
Stippled texture on the central fruit
3D extrusion effects on stars and lettering
Vibrant, warm color palette with high saturation

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The graphic is centered on a curved anatomical surface, occupying the middle third of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, yellow-orange central sphere acts as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Circular motion following the text, punctuated by outward-pointing stars that draw the eye to the edges of the emblem.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep shadows in the corners of the frame emphasize the lit area of the skin.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm yellow and orange for the central fruit and skin tones.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep green for the lettering fill to provide a cool counterpoint.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant pink and red for the stars and halo effects.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the graphic elements against a desaturated, naturally lit skin background.
paletteRestrictions: Must include heavy black for outlines

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Rounded, heavy-weight sans-serif with a 1970s bubble aesthetic.
letterConstructionRules: Curved baseline following the central sphere
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single decorative typeface used for all text to maintain emblem cohesion.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight and rounded terminals for a 70s look.
Captures the geometric bubble aesthetic of the era.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a close-up photo of human skin on a curved surface like a hip or shoulder, with soft directional lighting and deep shadows. In the center, place a flat-style illustration of a yellow grapefruit with black stippled texture and a thick black outline.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add custom bubble lettering in an arc above and below the fruit. Add 3D-extruded pink stars bursting from behind the fruit. Apply thick black outlines to all elements and a subtle red outer glow to the entire emblem.

verificationChecks: Is the text following a perfect circular arc?
Do all graphic elements have a consistent thick black outline?
Is the fruit texture represented by small dots/stippling?
Are the stars extruded with a 3D effect?

mustRedesign: Exact text content from the original
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the graphic looks like it is 'on' the skin rather than floating above it.
Check that the 3D extrusion of the stars points away from the center.
Verify the stippling on the fruit is visible but not overwhelming.
Confirm the lettering is legible despite the heavy weight and warp.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Central Citrus Subject] + [Circular Bubble Typography] + [3D Exploding Stars] + [Thick Black Outlines] + [Skin Texture Background] to recreate the 70s disco-tattoo aesthetic.
